The '''20 July 2024 Oceanside Retro Tournament''' was a [[Premiere - Death Star II]] tournament at Black Plague Brewing in Oceanside, California, starting at noon Pacific Time.<ref name="t84527">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=84527 P-DS2 Retro Tournament - July 20 - Vista, California], Leverandon, forum.starwarsccg.org (July 2024). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20240715165354/https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=84527 Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="dc-1262425125827907648">"A Premiere through Death Star 2 #SWCCG tournament will be held in Oceanside, California", Solidsnack3 in #cantina, SWCCG Players Committee Discord (15 July 2024). [https://discord.com/channels/401469156907679746/401469157587025922/1262425125827907648 Discord message]</ref>

The posted entry fee was $10, and the [[Players Committee]] was to provide prize support. Four games were planned if fewer than eight players entered, and six games if eight or more entered.<ref name="t84527" />
